watch.summary: A streamer gets intensely hyped pulling his team's jersey while watching a Valorant match, only to cope hysterically when they lose the crucial round.

beats.what: The streamer watches a tense 3v3 Valorant round in a pro match.
He pulls up his shirt to reveal a 100 Thieves jersey while chanting that it's their game.
The player fails to complete the clutch and dies.
He tries to cope by saying going to overtime is even better.
He breaks character and admits candidly that losing the round is definitely not what they wanted.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The clip relies on the contrast between intense fan hype and immediate cope when the round fails. The humor comes from his rapid shift from blind optimism to laughing defeat.
